records.title: De progressione dyadica
records.critical_edition: Editio princeps: Erich Hochstetter, Hermann-Josef Greve, Heinz Gumin (eds.), Herrn von Leibniz' Rechnung mit Null und Eins (Siemens AG, Berlin & Muenchen, 1966; 2nd ed. 1969; 3rd ed. 1979, ISBN 3-8009-1279-1). Not published in Gerhardt Math. Schr.; the public-domain printed binary paper is the 1703 Explication de l'Arithmetique Binaire.
records.notes: Rights cleared 2026-09 (see corpus/manuscripts/rights/de-progressione-dyadica-rights-2026-09.md): the 1679 text is public domain worldwide (author d. 1716; 70y p.m.a. lapsed 1786); the scientific-edition protection (§ 70 UrhG) and editio-princeps right (§ 71 UrhG) of the 1966 Siemens edition both lapsed 1991-12-31. Digitized sources: BibNum (Yves Serra, 'Le manuscrit De Progressione Dyadica de Leibniz', 2010, DOI 10.4000/bibnum.553 — facsimile + French translation, CC BY-SA 4.0) and GWLB scan-on-demand (public-domain digital copies freely usable with credit: 'Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Bibliothek – Niedersaechsische Landesbibliothek, LH XXXV, 3, 2'). Status remains source-identified-transcription-needed until the witness is acquired and a diplomatic transcription is made.
